title: Walk to Broadway | Boutique Stay | Sleeps 8
description:
Experience Nashville in this stylish mid-century modern, music-themed apartment, perfect for up to 8 guests. Features a vinyl lounge, fully equipped kitchen, private balcony, and resort-style amenities including a pool, gym, and yoga studio. Walk to Broadway's vibrant entertainment. Ideal for groups seeking comfort and city access in Music City.

STR PERMIT #2018074795

The space
Welcome to your stylish Nashville retreat, a true home away from home designed with a vibrant mid-century modern and music-centric theme. This apartment comfortably fits up to 8 guests, offering a relaxing haven after a day of exploring the city.

Key features include:
   Sleeping Arrangements:
    - 1 King bed
    - 2 Queen beds
    - 1 King pull out sleeper sofa
   Unique Amenities:
    - Vinyl listening lounge with a record player and a wall    adorned with vinyl records
    - Open-plan living room
    - Fully equipped kitchen
    - Dedicated coffee bar
    - Private balcony
    - 2 Full bathrooms
    - In unit washer/dryer
    - 2 Walk-in closets

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full private access to the entire apartment. Additionally, you'll enjoy access to an array of impressive resort-style community amenities, which include:
- Large swimming pool
- Private cabanas available for rent
- Spacious, modern gym featuring a climbing wall
- Yoga studio
- Outdoor grilling stations
- Various indoor and outdoor lounge areas and co-working spaces

Other things to note
Please keep the following in mind for your stay:
  - Parking: One reserved parking spot can be guaranteed for $30/night. If your group has more than one vehicle, other paid parking options are available onsite. Please reach out for details and I’ll be happy to help coordinate!
  - Host Availability: I am available to answer any questions you may have and help make your stay exceptional. Feel free to reach out at any time.

Need a little extra flexibility? Early check-in and late checkout may be available upon request, depending on our booking schedule.
